name: AvenuesAI Limited
summary: AvenuesAI Limited, a payment infrastructure company, provides digital payments and lending solutions for merchants, enterprises, corporations, governments, and financial institutions in India, the United Arab Emirates, and internationally. The company offers CCAvenue, a payment gateway that enables merchants to accept payments through websites and mobile devices; BillAvenue, a unified and interoperable bill-payment layer for utility and recurring payments; ResAvenue, an integrated digital hospitality platform; and Go Payments, which enables customers to access digital services through nearby physical touchpoints.
